json.justification: The meter (photo 14) sits on a brick wall with a car parked directly against the grass right beside it, and photos 9-11 show that same grass/gravel strip continuing toward a fence with the car clearly able to drive/park on it - so that stretch fails the drivable-surface clearance. Going the other direction from the meter (past the AC-window in photo 4, and the plain brick stretches in photos 15/16) the wall looks clear, but those shots are tight close-ups of brick with no ground visible, so I can't confirm width, depth, or surface there, and I can't tell how the wall relates to the meter or the fenced corner in photo 5. Because a plausible stretch of wall on the far side of the meter is unverified rather than confirmed-bad, this isn't a sure reject.
